description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator component, specifically testing its ability to resolve Node.js runtime versions by executing scripts, handling errors, and parsing version strings.

classes.name: RuntimeLocatorTests
classes.description: A structure encapsulating test cases for RuntimeLocator functionalities, including resolving runtime versions and handling errors.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified contents for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolve succeeds with valid node
methods.description: Test that verifies RuntimeLocator correctly resolves a valid Node.js executable and its version.

methods.name: resolve fails on boundary below minimum
methods.description: Test that checks the failure case when Node.js version is just below the minimum supported version.

methods.name: resolve fails when too old
methods.description: Test that verifies resolution fails when Node.js version is significantly below minimum supported.

methods.name: resolve fails when version unparsable
methods.description: Test that verifies resolution handles and reports errors when the version string cannot be parsed.

methods.name: describe failure includes paths
methods.description: Test that the failure message correctly includes the searched paths.

methods.name: runtime version parses with leading V and metadata
methods.description: Tests the parsing of version strings with leading 'v' and additional metadata like pre-release labels.
